name: Johnson & Johnson MedTech
description: Johnson & Johnson MedTech is the medical devices division of Johnson & Johnson, headquartered in New Brunswick, New Jersey, USA. Through its surgical and orthopedic subsidiaries (including DePuy Synthes and [Auris Health](/company/auris_health), acquired in 2019), the company develops the [VELYS](/robot/j&j_velys) orthopedic knee system, the [MONARCH](/robot/j&j_monarch) endoluminal bronchoscopy and urology platform, and the [OTTAVA](/robot/j&j_ottava) table-integrated multiport soft-tissue surgical robot.
